acceptanceCriteria: A fixture delta with bullet-form REMOVED entries lists each in excludedRequirements with its native name.
TestSTAV0003 covers the bullet form; spec STA-V0-003 text names the accepted REMOVED shapes.
body: OpenSpec 1.14.3 accepts REMOVED entries written as bullets ('- ### Requirement: X' style lists). The STA-V0-003 openspec-delta form (internal/lrfrepo/ocm_toolchain_forms.go, V1-1694) only lists level-3 '### Requirement:' headers under REMOVED in excludedRequirements, so bullet-form removals are silently absent. Expected: every REMOVED entry upstream recognises appears in excludedRequirements; actual: bullet entries dropped. Found in V1-1694 hand-back 2026-10-17.
